messages.subject: scaled data crashing glimmer
parts:
Hi everyone

As a complete beginner with Bayesian analyses, I have been using glimmer from the rethinking package to generate data and formula to pass to map2stan, like this:

A18F=glimmer(Rating~ (1+ PRE_CHI + ENT_CHI + Manner + End_State + SSplattering + SJoining + SStacking + SGluing + SSmearing |Participant) + (1|Verb) + PRE_CHI + ENT_CHI + Manner + End_State + SSplattering + SJoining + SStacking + SGluing + SSmearing, data=FigAdult, family=gaussian, prefix=c("b_","v_"), default_prior="dnorm(0,1)")
A18F_Full=map2stan(A18F$f, data=A18F$d)

This was all working fine, until I tried centering the DV:

Data$Rating=scale(Data$Rating)

The scaling seems to be working correctly (when I inspect the data on a plot), but when I try to run the glimmer command, I get the following error:

Error in `[[<-.data.frame`(`*tmp*`, pf$yname, value = c(-1.75280421290128,  : 
  attempt to select less than one element in OneIndex

From googling the error message, this seems to be associated with trying to select data that doesn't exist, but I don't see how that applies in my case

Can anyone help?
Thanks
Ben

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: scaled data crashing glimmer
parts:
On Monday, April 24, 2017 at 11:55:16 AM UTC-4, Ben Ambridge wrote:
This was all working fine, until I tried centering the DV:

Data$Rating=scale(Data$Rating)

The scaling seems to be working correctly (when I inspect the data on a plot), but when I try to run the glimmer command, I get the following error:

The scale() function produces a matrix that has one column in your case. You probably want a vector, in which case do

Data$Rating <- scale(Data$Rating)[,1]

However, standardizing the outcome variable is non-Bayesian.

Ben
